create_epsilon_greedy_policy: create an EpsilonGreedyPolicy instance with a value function dict and list of actions
get_action_epsilon_greedy: get an action from EpsilonGreedyPolicy using an epsilon value and current state
create_q_learning_agent: create a QLearning agent with configurable learning rate, epsilon, and discount factor
step_q_learning_agent: step the QLearning agent with a timestep to get the next action
begin_episode_q_learning: begin a new episode by resetting the QLearning agent state and action
